beats.say: On 11 April 1970, Apollo 13 launched from Kennedy Space Center. But an explosion two days later turned the mission into a rescue operation.
An oxygen tank in the service module exploded, disabling the electrical and life support system.
The crew transferred to the Lunar Module as a lifeboat, and Mission Control in Houston improvised new procedures.
They successfully improvised a solution for the carbon dioxide scrubber system, and tens of millions watched the splashdown in the South Pacific.
